s: I am Maya, and this is my friend Lena.
Today we learn five new words: shirt, pants, dress, shoes, and hat.
You wear a shirt on your body.
Do you have a shirt, Lena?
I wear my white shirt with pants.
Pants are clothes for your legs.
I wear my blue pants to school.
A dress is one piece of clothes.
A dress is for a woman or a girl.
My sister has a red dress.
She wears her dress to a party.
I wear my shoes every day.
A hat goes on your head.
My big hat is for sunny days.
I wear my hat in the summer.
